thread:
customer-ops: Heads up — enterprise customer EU-Corp is seeing high p90 latency (~300-800ms). They say traffic should be in eu-west-1 but traces show calls routing to us-west. sample trace: tr-9a8b7c. Can someone check region routing + healthchecks?
amelia: Got it, looking. Do we have the request-id or client IP? Any repro steps from the customer? :eyes: 
customer-ops: They sent this curl and headers: 
```
curl -H 'x-request-id: tr-9a8b7c' -H 'x-client-region: eu-west-1' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Client IPs: 185.50.22.11, 185.50.22.12. Happened ~10:10 UTC.
sanjay: I pulled routing logs for tr-9a8b7c. The control-plane healthcheck marked eu-west pool UNHEALTHY at 10:09:58 due to probe misses, so SmartRouter fell back to us-west. Affinity for this customer is sticky (customer-level policy) so subsequent sessions remained pinned to us-west for TTL.
Logs snippet: 
```
[10:09:58] probe-eu-west: missed=3/3, status=UNHEALTHY, ttl=12s
[10:10:00] smartrouter: route decision -> us-west-pool (latency_est 45ms) fallback_reason=probe_unhealthy
[10:10:02] session-affinity: set sticky_region=us-west, ttl=300s
```
leo: That TTL=12s on probe checks is suspicious. If we have transient packet loss or short GC pauses, 3 misses -> unhealthy is aggressive. Combined with sticky session TTL=300s, that creates cross-region stickiness even after probes recover. This looks like false-positive-induced failover.
amelia: Customer reports reproducible in short bursts. Can we repro in lab? Any immediate mitigation we can apply without impacting other customers?
sanjay: Temp mitigation plan applied at 10:20 UTC: bumped probe check TTL + hysteresis and disabled immediate sticky override for the customer. Commands run: 
```
# increase probe resilience
kubectl patch cm redwood-probes -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"eu_probe_miss_threshold":"5","eu_probe_interval_s":"5"}}'
# disable sticky override for customer
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://control-plane.redwood.ai/config/affinity -d '{"customer":"EU-Corp","sticky_override":false}'
```
oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-424 (severity: p2) — auto-notify oncall.
customer-ops: After the change customer reports latency back to ~60-90ms for the last 7m. They see requests back in eu-west.
leo: Good. Next steps: 1) run a sweep to identify other customers using sticky_override + short probe TTLs, 2) add a guard in SmartRouter preventing sticky rebind for X seconds after a region fallback, 3) longer-term: expose probe hysteresis recommendations in Optimize.
amelia: I'll own the customer comms and confirm recovery. Will also open a follow-up with eng-platform for config hardening. :thumbsup: 
sanjay: I'll make a quick PR to lift the miss threshold and add better probe metrics (probe_flap_rate per-region). Link PR when ready.
customer-ops: Confirmed — EU-Corp is happy for now. Leaving monitoring on for 24h. Thanks team. :relieved:
